title: Delicate American Pancake French Toast with Chocolate
description: A twist on the classic French toast recipe using delicate American pancakes and topped with rich chocolate. This dish is a perfect breakfast or brunch option.
instructions: In a shallow dish, whisk together eggs, milk, cinnamon, and vanilla extract.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Dip each pancake into the egg mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Place the coated pancake on the skillet or griddle and cook for 2-3 minutes or until golden brown.
Flip the pancake and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes or until golden brown.
Melt the chocolate chips in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
To assemble, place a cooked pancake on a serving plate and top with melted chocolate and a sprinkle of cinnamon.
